summary: Audited EuroComply production readiness surfaces on main. No open PRs were found. Main commit 3762c6fe has Vercel success but no GitHub Actions workflow runs, so build/security remain unverified. A safe config/supply-chain drift was identified: @clerk/nextjs remains declared in package.json and package-lock.json while repository search found no Clerk runtime imports/usages; project auth is Supabase-based. The dependency should be removed with a regenerated lockfile via npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts before merge.
actions_taken: Checked repository metadata and confirmed main as default branch.
Confirmed latest main has Vercel success but no GitHub Actions workflow runs.
Reviewed release scripts and confirmed release:production-final remains wired to scripts/release/run-public-production-release.mjs.
Reviewed /api/ready and confirmed bearer-token protection and no-store response behavior.
Reviewed vercel.json and confirmed a single cron entry pointing to /api/internal/daily-maintenance.
Reviewed /api/internal/daily-maintenance and confirmed internal cron authorization, no-store responses, configured base URL guard, and bounded job timeout.
Reviewed /api/prelaunch and confirmed bounded JSON, consent gate, honeypot, rate limit, and no-store behavior.
Reviewed billing checkout and confirmed authenticated user, organization scope, manage_billing RBAC, trusted mutation/rate-limit, step-up, self-serve plan boundary, audit log, and no-store response.

Searched for Clerk runtime imports/usages and found none while @clerk/nextjs is still declared in dependency manifests. Prepared this audit log entry instead of directly editing dependency manifests because the lockfile must be regenerated atomically to avoid package-lock drift.
recommended_safe_fix: Regenerate package-lock.json with npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts on Node 22/npm 10.
Run npm ci, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run test, npm run build, and npm run security:ci before merging.
agent_log_json_note: Direct rewrite of the large historical agent_log.json was not attempted to avoid truncating or losing audit history; this append-only log shard records the audit safely.
